explanation: Double-quoted strings support variable interpolation and escape sequences like \n, \t, while single-quoted strings do not interpolate variables and only recognize \\ and \\
The null coalescing operator ?? is syntactic sugar for isset($var) ? $var : default, so it suppresses 'Undefined variable' notices/warnings by design.
In PHP, echo with multiple comma-separated arguments outputs them concatenated without any separator.
print возвращает 1, но поскольку это языковая конструкция (language construct), а не функция, она не может использоваться внутри выражения.
The Elvis operator `$a ?: $b` returns the left operand if it is truthy, not falsy; if it is falsy, it returns the right operand.
In PHP, addition and subtraction (+, -) have higher operator precedence than concatenation (.), so expressions like 1+2.3 are parsed as (1+2).3.
The ** operator in PHP is right-associative, so 2 ** 3 ** 2 is evaluated as 2 ** (3 ** 2) = 2 ** 9 = 512, not (2 ** 3) ** 2 = 64.
Concatenation '.' has higher precedence than '+', so it's parsed as ('сумма: ' . 2) + 3, which gives 'сумма: 2' + 3, the string converts to 0, and 0 + 3 = 3.
При строгом сравнении === порядок ключей и значений в массивах имеет значение: массивы равны только при полном совпадении и порядке.
The == operator is a loose (non-strict) comparison, and 0 == false actually returns true in PHP.
In PHP 8, when a non-numeric string is loosely compared to an integer, the integer is cast to a string, so 'abc' == 0 becomes 'abc' == '0', which is false.
In PHP, loose comparison (==) with null returns true for 0, empty string '', and false due to type juggling rules.
PHP casts a string to int by reading valid numeric characters from the start until it hits a non-numeric character, so '42abc' becomes 42.
PHP converts the numeric string '5' to integer 5 and adds it to 5, yielding 10.
В PHP приведение false к строке даёт пустую строку "", а не "0".
Due to IEEE 754 floating-point precision, 0.1 + 0.2 equals 0.30000000000000004, so the strict comparison === with 0.3 yields false.
strrev() reverses a string byte-by-byte, so it breaks multi-byte UTF-8 characters; for correct UTF-8 reversal you need mb_strrev() or a manual multi-byte-aware implementation.
str_contains('Hello world', 'world') indeed returns true because the substring 'world' is present in the string 'Hello world'.
str_pad() supports three pad types: STR_PAD_RIGHT (default), STR_PAD_LEFT, and STR_PAD_BOTH.
By default trim() removes ' \t\n\r\0\x0B' — spaces, tabs, newlines, carriage returns, NUL, and vertical tabs, not just spaces.
Each Cyrillic character in 'привет' (6 characters) is encoded as 2 bytes in UTF-8, so strlen returns 6 × 2 = 12 bytes.
substr with offset -3 starts 3 characters from the end of 'abcdef', returning the last 3 characters 'def'.
ucfirst() возвращает новую строку с заглавной первой буквой, не изменяя исходную строку на месте.
In PHP, heredoc (<<<EOT) allows variable interpolation just like double-quoted strings, while nowdoc (<<<'EOT') treats the content as a single-quoted string with no interpolation.
sort() пересортирует массив и пересоздаёт числовые ключи; для сохранения связи ключей и значений используется asort().
PHP automatically converts numeric string keys like '5' to integer keys (5) when storing them in an array.
in_array() по умолчанию использует нестрогое сравнение (==), так как третий параметр $strict имеет значение false по умолчанию.
array_filter() без колбэка действительно удаляет все falsy-значения (false, 0, '0', '', null, []), оставляя только truthy элементы.
The $preserve_keys parameter of array_slice() defaults to false, so by default the array is re-indexed starting from 0.
array_slice starts at offset 1 (element 20) and takes 2 elements, returning [20, 30].
The + operator preserves left-array keys over right ones, so 'a' stays 1 and 'b' is added, giving 2 elements.
PHP 8.1 расширила spread-оператор для массивов, позволив использовать его с массивами, имеющими строковые ключи (ранее работали только последовательные целочисленные ключи).
In PHP 8.0+ you can combine named arguments with the spread operator in the same call, as long as named arguments come before the spread (e.g., func(a: 1, ...$args)).
In PHP, a closure without a use clause does NOT have access to variables from the outer scope; they must be explicitly imported via use.
func_num_args() возвращает количество аргументов, переданных при вызове функции, а не количество объявленных параметров, поэтому f(1, 2, 3) даст 3.
Arrow functions (fn) in PHP have exactly one expression as their body without curly braces; multiple statements require a regular closure with curly braces.
Стрелочные функции (fn) в PHP захватывают внешние переменные по значению (by value) в момент создания, а не по ссылке (by reference).
A static closure in PHP explicitly does not bind $this, so it cannot access the current object context.
The `use ($x)` clause captures the value of $x (5) by value at the time the closure is created, so later reassignment to 7 does not affect the captured value.
In coercive (weak) typing mode, PHP automatically converts numeric strings like "5" to int when passed to a parameter declared as int.
Property promotion was introduced in PHP 8.0, allowing properties to be declared directly in constructor parameters with visibility modifiers.
In PHP, the 'final' keyword before a method declaration prevents it from being overridden in child classes.
In PHP, the final keyword on a method prevents it from being overridden in any subclass.
In PHP, private properties are accessible only within the class where they are declared, not in child classes.
Anonymous class names in PHP are formed as 'class@anonymous\0file_path\0line', so the part before the first null byte is 'class@anonymous'.
In PHP, private methods are not part of the inheritance contract and are invisible to child classes, so a child can freely declare a method with the same name and any visibility without conflict.
__get() вызывается не только для несуществующих, но и для недоступных (private/protected) свойств при обращении извне класса.
Повторное присваивание readonly-свойства в PHP бросает Error (не Exception).
PHP interfaces can declare constants, which are implicitly public and accessed via ClassName::CONST_NAME.
In PHP, the 'instanceof' operator checks whether an object is an instance of a specific class or implements a specific interface.
In PHP, interface methods must be public and non-static; static methods are not allowed in interface declarations.
In PHP, instanceof checks both class inheritance and interface implementation, so $obj instanceof SomeInterface returns true if the object implements that interface.
In PHP, interface methods must be abstract (no implementation); only traits can provide default method implementations.
In PHP, abstract methods in an abstract class can be declared with public, protected, or private (since PHP 7.1) visibility, so protected is perfectly valid.
Foo::cases() returns an array of all enum cases, and this enum has exactly 3 cases: A, B, C.
In PHP, traits are allowed to declare constants, and those constants become accessible through any class that uses the trait.
В PHP 7+ интерфейс Throwable является общим предком (interface), который реализуют и Exception, и Error, позволяя перехватывать оба типа в одном catch.
TypeError наследуется от Error, а не от Exception, поэтому catch (Exception $e) его не перехватит.
The @ operator suppresses error messages (warnings, notices, errors) but does not prevent exceptions from being thrown; exceptions must still be caught with try/catch.
In PHP, intdiv(5, 0) throws a DivisionByZeroError exception (a subclass of ArithmeticError).
In PHP, the finally block always executes regardless of whether an exception was thrown or caught; it runs after the try block in all cases.
An exception thrown in a finally block in PHP replaces (suppresses) any exception from the try block, directly affecting the outcome.
In PHP, casting any object (including new Exception('x')) to bool always yields true.
Shutdown functions registered via register_shutdown_function() are executed during the shutdown phase, which occurs when the script ends normally, when exit()/die() is called, or on a fatal error.
The use directive only creates a local alias for the FQCN; the file is actually loaded later by the autoloader when the class is referenced.
In PHP, you import a function with the syntax 'use function Vendor\Package\functionName;'
PSR-4 removes the 'App\' prefix, converts remaining namespace parts to directory paths, and appends the class name with .php extension.
Composer's vendor/autoload.php calls spl_autoload_register() to register its ClassLoader's loadClass method as an autoloader.
__NAMESPACE__ is a PHP magic constant that returns the name of the current namespace (empty string if in the global namespace).
In PHP, a relative class name (without a leading \) in `new` is resolved relative to the current namespace, not the global root.
PSR-4 removes the prefix 'App\' and maps the remaining 'Model\User' to the path 'src/Model/User.php'.
In PHP, a `use` statement inside a function body is allowed and creates an alias valid from that point to the end of the current scope (i.e., for the rest of that function).
In PHP, arrays are value types: assigning an array creates a full copy, so modifications to one do not affect the other unless explicit references are used.
In PHP, arrays are copied by value, so modifying $b does not affect $a; $a remains [1, 2] and count($a) is 2.
In PHP, variables declared in global scope are not visible inside a function unless accessed via the global keyword, $GLOBALS, or passed as an argument.
$GLOBALS['x'] is a direct reference to the global-scope variable, so unset() removes it globally, not just within the function.
The parameter $x is passed by reference, so inc() modifies the original variable $n, incrementing it from 5 to 6.
Foreach по значению итерирует по внутренней копии массива, поэтому добавление/удаление элементов внутри цикла не влияет на текущий проход.
Static properties belong to the class itself, so all instances share the same value and changes are visible everywhere.
In PHP, boolean keys are cast to integers: true becomes 1 and false becomes 0, so the key is stored as int, not bool.
In PHP generators, return with a value sets the generator's return value, accessible via $gen->getReturn() after the generator is fully exhausted.
In PHP, once a generator is fully exhausted it cannot be restarted; you must call the generator function again to obtain a new generator object.
yield from действительно делегирует итерацию другому генератору или итерируемому объекту, извлекая и возвращая его значения по одному.
A function with yield is a generator; calling it returns a Generator object, and get_class() on it returns the string 'Generator'.
The generator yields 1, 2, 3 from the array, iterator_to_array produces an array with 3 elements, and count returns 3.
SplStack implements a LIFO (Last In, First Out) stack, not a FIFO queue; SplQueue is the class that implements a FIFO queue.
ArrayIterator is a built-in PHP class that implements Iterator, allowing you to wrap an array and iterate over it via the Iterator interface.
ArrayObject implements Iterator/IteratorAggregate interfaces, so it can be iterated with foreach normally.
password_hash() автоматически генерирует случайную соль и включает её в результирующий хэш, отдельный параметр для соли не требуется.
PASSWORD_DEFAULT in PHP 8 is bcrypt (cost 10), not MD5 with salt.
password_verify checks if the plaintext password matches the hash; since both use 'secret', it returns true.
strip_tags() удаляет HTML/PHP-теги и помогает от XSS, но не защищает от SQL-инъекций — для этого нужны подготовленные выражения (prepared statements) или экранирование специальных символов БД.
session_regenerate_id() generates a new session ID, which prevents an attacker from reusing a previously known session ID after login (session fixation attack).
The built-in function php_sapi_name() returns the name of the current SAPI module, such as 'cli' for command-line usage.
session_destroy() удаляет данные сессии на сервере, но не удаляет cookie PHPSESSID в браузере — для этого нужно отдельно вызвать setcookie с прошедшим временем истечения.
Массив $_SESSION наполняется данными сессии только после вызова session_start() (или включения session.auto_start); без этого он пуст.
array_find() is not a built-in PHP function in any released version of PHP.
Property hooks (get/set в объявлении свойства) были действительно добавлены в PHP 8.4.
Asymmetric visibility (e.g., public private(set) string $name) was indeed introduced as a new feature in PHP 8.4.
The #[\NoDiscard] attribute was introduced in PHP 8.4 to mark that a function's return value should not be silently discarded.
The pipeline operator (|>) was introduced as a new feature in PHP 8.4.
The 'Clone With' syntax (clone($obj, ['x' => 1])) was accepted as an RFC for PHP 8.4, allowing shallow cloning with property overrides.
Функции array_first() и array_last() не существуют в стандартной библиотеке PHP ни в одной версии.
The First-class callable syntax RFC (enabling partial function application) was accepted for PHP 8.1.
The clamp() function was introduced in PHP 8.3 via the RFC clamp_v2.
There is no PHP RFC called 'Context Managers v2' that has been accepted; this appears to be a fabricated RFC name.
The Bound-Erased Generic Types RFC was rejected in 2024, not 2026.
As of the given date, no RFC to make ZTS (Zend Thread Safety) the default build in PHP has been accepted; it remains an optional compilation flag.
PHP 8.5 (planned for November 2025) does not include built-in generics/parametric types; no such RFC has been accepted as of the latest PHP releases.
PHP 8.6 is scheduled for GA on 19.11.2026, so on 07.11.2026 the latest stable release is indeed PHP 8.5.
PHP 6 was planned but never released; the next major version after PHP 5.6 was PHP 7.0 (released December 2015).
The RFC to add the #[\Deprecated] attribute was accepted and included in PHP 8.4, allowing developers to mark code as deprecated with an optional recommended alternative.
В чистой и луковичной архитектурах правило зависимостей требует, чтобы все зависимости были направлены к центру (домен), а внутренние слои не знали о внешних.
In proper DDD, domain entities are pure PHP objects independent of Doctrine/Symfony, using only language constructs and possibly the standard library.
Controllers and Twig templates belong to the presentation (interface) layer; calling use cases is their responsibility, but it does not place them in the business-logic/domain layer.
В самом центре луковичной архитектуры (Onion Architecture) находится домен — ядро бизнес-логики и сущностей, от которого не зависят внешние слои.
DePTRAC и подобные инструменты (например, PHPStan с правилами, ArchUnit) действительно автоматически нарушают сборку при обнаружении запрещённых межслойных зависимостей.
Use cases (interactors) should be framework-agnostic and depend on abstractions, not on concrete infrastructure objects like an HTTP Request or an EntityManager.
In DDD, a Repository is a component that provides a collection of aggregates/entities and abstracts the storage mechanism behind a unified interface.
In Clean Architecture the domain and use-case layers depend only on abstractions (interfaces), so swapping the concrete database is confined to the outer infrastructure/adapter layer.

An Aggregate in DDD is a cluster of domain objects treated as a single unit for consistency; it is a conceptual boundary in the domain model, not a database table (it can span multiple tables, and a table can hold parts of several aggregates).
Value Object в DDD действительно неизменяем (immutable) и равенство определяется по значениям полей, а не по уникальному идентификатору.
В DDD Aggregate Root (Корень агрегата) — единственная точка внешнего входа, через которую проходят все изменения агрегата.
In DDD, repositories are defined per aggregate root, not per individual entity; entities within an aggregate are accessed and persisted through the root.
Ubiquitous Language in DDD is indeed a single shared language of the domain model used consistently by both developers and domain experts to eliminate ambiguity and ensure a common understanding.
Горизонт — граница, внутри которой модель и её язык образуют единое целое, а за ней те же понятия относятся к другим моделям.
DDD recommends a rich (behavioral) domain model where entities and value objects encapsulate business logic, not an anemic model with logic pushed into services.
Bounded Context in DDD explicitly means each context has its own model and ubiquitous language, so the same real-world concept is represented by different classes in different contexts.
By default Symfony DI container generates lazy proxies, so the real service instance is only instantiated on the first method call.
The Symfony command `debug:router` (invoked via `php bin/console debug:router`) lists all registered routes in the application.
Autowiring в Symfony как раз устраняет необходимость вручную перечислять сервисы — зависимости автоматически разрешаются по типам в сигнатурах конструкторов/методов.
Twig компилирует шаблоны в PHP-классы (наследники Twig\Template) и сохраняет их в кэше, чтобы не повторять компиляцию при следующих запросах.
In Symfony's dev environment the container is cached and only recompiled when a tracked file (service, config, etc.) has changed, not on every request.
The SYMFONY_ENV environment variable is used to select the active Symfony environment (e.g. dev, prod, test).
In Symfony, controller action methods must be public; the HttpKernel invokes them via reflection and cannot call private methods from outside the class.
Priority is determined by the numeric priority value, not by whether the listener is an EventSubscriber or a regular listener; both use the same priority mechanism.
The guard system was deprecated in Symfony 5.3 and removed in Symfony 6.0, with authentication now handled by classes implementing AuthenticatorInterface.
The #[IsGranted] attribute (Symfony 6.3+) is placed directly on a controller action method and throws AccessDeniedException (403) if the user lacks the specified role or permission.
Voters in Symfony implement VoterInterface and are used via isGranted() to check access to a specific object (subject) based on attributes like 'EDIT'.
Starting with Symfony 6, docblock annotations for validation were removed, and Symfony 7+ exclusively uses PHP 8 attributes (e.g. #[Assert\NotBlank]) for declaring validation constraints.
Symfony's Form component automatically generates and validates a CSRF token on every form submission by default.
Symfony form validation is always executed server-side; HTML5 client-side checks are only a UX convenience and do not replace the server-side validation.
The Symfony MakerBundle command 'php bin/console make:form' generates a FormType class.
Symfony stores the authenticated user's identifier and token in the session, not the password; the password is only used once during credential verification against the stored hash.
In Symfony 4+ the config/packages/ directory is the standard location for per-bundle or per-topic configuration files (e.g. framework.yaml, doctrine.yaml, security.yaml).
This is a standard practice: a committed .env with safe dev defaults ensures reproducibility, while .env.local (gitignored) holds real secrets per developer/environment.
The Symfony command 'bin/console debug:container' lists all registered services in the service container along with their aliases.
Symfony's container is compiled at build time; parameters are baked into the compiled container and are not meant to be mutated at runtime via setParameter() in a controller.
By default, services in Symfony are private (public: false), not public; you must explicitly set public: true to retrieve them from the container.
Many bundles work fine with their default settings without any file in config/packages; a config file is only needed when you want to override defaults.
В Symfony переменные окружения подставляются в конфигурационных YAML-файлах (включая services.yaml) именно через синтаксис %env(VAR)%, где VAR — имя переменной.
In Symfony, the APP_DEBUG environment variable controls debug mode, enabling the profiler and Twig debug features.
Symfony Messenger allows a single message to be routed to multiple handlers simultaneously via the bus routing configuration.
The sync transport handles the message immediately in the current process without any queue or worker; only async transports use queues and workers.
В Symfony Messenger-компоненте воркер для обработки сообщений из очередей запускается командой messenger:consume.
В Symfony Messenger retry_strategy (max_retries, delay, multiplier) настраивается непосредственно в конфигурации каждого транспорта.
By default, Symfony Messenger uses the Symfony Serializer component with JSON as the serialization format for messages.
Symfony Scheduler (введён в Symfony 7.2) по расписанию порождает сообщения, которые отправляются через компонент Messenger для асинхронной обработки.
Symfony Messenger provides a built-in Doctrine transport that persists messages in database tables via Doctrine DBAL/ORM.
Symfony Messenger allows you to define custom middleware in the bus configuration array and position them before or after built-in middleware.
Мажорные релизы Symfony (x.0) выходят ежегодно в ноябре, а не раз в два года; минорные действительно каждые полгода (май и ноябрь).
Symfony 8 требует минимально PHP 8.4.
Symfony 7.0 полностью удалила поддержку аннотаций в докблоках, оставив только PHP 8 attributes.
AssetMapper (Symfony 6.4+) позволяет управлять CSS/JS-ассетами и ES-модулями без Node.js и webpack, используя importmap.php для декларирования импортов.
Symfony 6.4 is a regular release (not LTS); the LTS releases were 2.7, 3.4, 4.4, and 5.4.
Major Symfony releases remove features that were deprecated in the previous major version; that is the whole purpose of the deprecation cycle.
Symfony provides UPGRADE-*.md files for each major release documenting breaking changes and migration steps.
Symfony's AssetMapper component (introduced in 6.4/7.0) manages JS/CSS assets and importmaps without requiring Node.js or webpack.
Symfony .2 minor releases are typically made in late November, so Symfony 8.2 would not yet be released on 07.11.2026.
Symfony 8.2 по стандартному циклу выходит в ноябре 2026.
Following semantic versioning, the next minor release after 8.1 is 8.2.
Symfony 8.2 is a minor release (x.2) within the 8.x major line; only x.0 releases (e.g. 8.0) break backward compatibility and require updating to new APIs.
PHP guarantees backward compatibility within the same major version (8.x), so upgrading from 8.1 to 8.2 should not require code changes.
Symfony releases four minor versions per major cycle (x.1–x.4), so 8.4 is the last minor before 9.0.
Symfony 8.x is expected to require PHP 8.4, not PHP 8.5.
According to Symfony's deprecation policy, deprecations introduced in a given major version (8.x) are scheduled for removal in the next major version (9.0), so they will not be removed before 9.0.

Twig's {{ }} expressions support a limited set of operations (variable access, method calls on exposed objects, filters, simple operators) but do not allow arbitrary PHP code like direct function calls on native PHP functions or complex PHP syntax.
Twig has auto-escaping enabled by default (html strategy), so variables output with {{ }} are automatically escaped to prevent XSS.
The |e filter (alias of |escape) defaults to the 'html' strategy, which applies htmlspecialchars to make output safe in HTML context.
The 'number_format' filter in twig/intl-extra formats a number with locale awareness using PHP's NumberFormatter.
The |raw filter in Blade (Laravel) outputs a value without HTML-encoding, disabling auto-escaping.
In Twig, {{ }} prints/outputs an expression's value, while {% %} executes control-structure tags such as if, for, set, etc.
In Twig you can declare variables inside a template using the {% set %} tag (e.g. {% set foo = 'bar' %}), so values are not limited to being passed only from the controller.
Twig's dump() function outputs a detailed debug representation of a variable (array, object, etc.).
Bootstrap is a CSS/JS component library for building responsive UIs, not a SPA framework like React or Angular.
The .container class in Bootstrap provides a responsive fixed-width container that sets max-width at each breakpoint (e.g., 540px, 720px, 960px, 1140px, 1320px).
Bootstrap's grid divides a row into 12 columns (not 16), and modern Bootstrap (4+) uses CSS Flexbox rather than float.
Bootstrap 5 has six breakpoints (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl), but xs has no infix in class names, so exactly five (sm, md, lg, xl, xxl) use infixes.
In Bootstrap, utilities like .mt-3 or .px-2 multiply the $spacer variable by the numeric suffix (e.g., 3 × $spacer) to compute the final spacing value.
In Bootstrap 5, the data-bs-toggle attribute is used to initialize interactive components such as dropdowns, modals, and collapse on an element.
Bootstrap 5 полностью отказалась от jQuery; все интерактивные компоненты (dropdown, modal, tooltip и др.) реализованы на чистом vanilla JavaScript.
In Bootstrap 5, dark mode is enabled by adding the data-bs-theme="dark" attribute to the <html> element, not by adding a .dark class.
Doctrine ORM не создаёт таблицы автоматически при первом обращении; схему нужно создать явно через migrations или schema-update.
EntityManager::persist() marks a new entity as managed (pending insertion) without issuing any SQL until flush() is called.
In Doctrine ORM 3, EntityManager::merge() was removed; the merge functionality is now provided by the EntityRepository (getRepository()->merge()).
DQL operates at the entity/field level, abstracting away the underlying database tables and columns.
Doctrine's repository find() method returns null when no entity with the given ID exists in the database.
DoctrineBundle по умолчанию (auto_commit: true) вызывает EntityManager::flush() в конце каждого HTTP-запроса через listener на событие kernel.response.
Unit of Work performs dirty-checking on managed entities, so flush() detects property changes and issues UPDATE without needing a new persist() call.
In Doctrine ORM, remove() only marks the entity for deletion in the UnitOfWork; the actual SQL DELETE is executed on flush().
MVCC в PostgreSQL как раз устраняет взаимные блокировки: читатели не блокируют писателей и писатели не блокируют читателей.
The EXPLAIN command (or EXPLAIN PLAN in Oracle) displays the query execution plan without actually running the query.

SERIAL creates a separate sequence plus a DEFAULT nextval() on a regular column, while GENERATED AS IDENTITY creates a SQL-standard identity column with an implicitly managed sequence; they differ in internal implementation and behavior.
In PostgreSQL, a UNIQUE constraint treats NULL values as distinct, so multiple rows with NULL in that column are allowed.
PostgreSQL's string_agg(expression, delimiter) aggregate function concatenates strings with a specified separator.
Обычный VACUUM лишь помечает пространство мёртвых кортежей как доступное для повторного использования внутри файла таблицы, а не возвращает его ОС; для этого нужен VACUUM FULL.
PARTITION BY в определении window-функции (OVER clause) разделяет строки на группы, для каждой из которых функция вычисляется независимо.
READ COMMITTED only prevents dirty reads; non-repeatable reads are prevented starting at the REPEATABLE READ level.
By default PostgreSQL runs in autocommit mode, so each individual SQL statement is automatically committed in its own implicit transaction unless explicitly wrapped in BEGIN/COMMIT.
COMMIT завершает транзакцию и сохраняем все внесённые изменения в базе данных.
Indexes are used by the query optimizer for any operation that needs to locate rows (SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE), so a WHERE clause on an indexed column speeds up all of them, not just SELECT.
SAVEPOINT позволяет отметить точку внутри транзакции и откатиться к ней, обеспечивая частичный откат операций.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the query to collect actual timing and row count statistics, unlike plain EXPLAIN which only shows the plan.
